requirements.Title: AI Productivity and Manageability Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate advanced AI-driven productivity features and scan workflow solutions, as well as manageability tools, into the Magellan printer to simplify business operations for SMBs.
requirements.Rationale: Target customers (unmanaged/lightly managed SMBs) require easy-to-use, efficient management and productivity tools without dedicated IT staff.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires software and firmware support for AI features and portal integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer includes AI-powered print/scan features and a management portal accessible to office managers/generalists; verified via feature demo and user testing.

requirements.Title: Lowest Business Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)
requirements.Description: Design Magellan to deliver HP’s lowest business TCO in the SMB segment, minimizing intervention and maintenance costs.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs are highly cost-sensitive and require solutions that reduce ongoing operational expenses.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires hardware design for efficiency, supply chain for affordable consumables, and warranty/service model alignment.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Verified TCO analysis shows Magellan is lowest among HP business printers for SMBs; independent validation or internal benchmarking completed.

requirements.Title: High Serviceability & Customer Replaceable Parts
requirements.Description: Ensure key components (e.g., maintenance box) are customer replaceable and design for easy serviceability, with PHA (Primary Hardware Assembly) replaceable by customer and MINK at service center if out of warranty.
requirements.Rationale: SMB customers lack IT staff and need minimal downtime, so easy part replacement is critical.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires hardware design for tool-less or simple replacement and clear documentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Field test demonstrates customer can replace designated parts without technical support; documented in user manual.

requirements.Title: Keyed Bottles for Ink Supply
requirements.Description: Implement keyed ink bottles to prevent incorrect refilling and ensure compatibility with Magellan printers.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces user errors, improves reliability, and protects supply revenue.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires new bottle design and printer hardware interface.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Keyed bottles pass usability and compatibility tests; only correct bottles can be inserted and used.

requirements.Title: Support for SMB2.0 Solutions & Advanced View SMB Portal
requirements.Description: Integrate Magellan with HP's SMB2.0 Solutions and Advanced View SMB portal for device and fleet management.
requirements.Rationale: Enables efficient management for target SMB customers, enhances product value.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires portal backend integration and device firmware support.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal recognizes, manages, and reports on Magellan devices in customer environments.

requirements.Title: PaaS (Platform as a Service) Support
requirements.Description: Ensure Magellan supports HP's Platform as a Service (PaaS) offerings for flexible business models.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with HP's strategic intent to accelerate PaaS and address evolving customer needs.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires backend and firmware support for PaaS.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Magellan can be deployed and managed as part of HP’s PaaS portfolio; validated by IT and business team integration tests.

requirements.Title: PDL/PS Support and Speed Enhancement
requirements.Description: For PDL SKUs, support PDL/PS and achieve minimum print speeds of 25/20 ppm (improved from current 25/19).
requirements.Rationale: Meets higher performance needs for certain SMB segments and maintains competitive positioning.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires hardware and firmware capable of supporting specified speeds and PDL/PS.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Independent lab validation of print speeds and PDL/PS functionality for PDL SKUs.

requirements.Title: Blue Angel Certification for PDL SKU
requirements.Description: Obtain Blue Angel environmental certification for PDL SKUs of Magellan.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses sustainability requirements and competitive differentiation in regulated markets.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires compliance with Blue Angel standards and documentation submission.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Blue Angel certification awarded for PDL SKU.

requirements.Title: Replaceable Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Design Magellan with a user-replaceable maintenance box as a new feature for HP OJ Pro with Ink Tanks.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces downtime and service costs for SMB customers; new feature for this segment.
requirements.Dependencies: Depends on hardware design and supply chain for replacement parts.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: User can replace the maintenance box without technical support; validated by usability testing.

requirements.Title: Perfect Print and Perfect Scan with AI
requirements.Description: Deliver advanced AI-powered print and scan features branded as 'Perfect Print' and 'Perfect Scan' for superior document quality and workflow automation.
requirements.Rationale: Key differentiator and top customer need for productivity and efficiency.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires AI software stack and hardware support.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Independent testing confirms improved accuracy and efficiency in print/scan tasks versus baseline.

requirements.Title: Sustainability: 60% Recycled Content Plastic (RCP)
requirements.Description: Ensure Magellan is built with at least 60% recycled content plastic (RCP), exceeding main competitors.
requirements.Rationale: Meets rising customer and regulatory demands for sustainability, and outperforms competitors (Epson 30%).
requirements.Dependencies: Supply chain and materials sourcing for recycled plastics.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Third-party verification of RCP percentage in shipped units.

requirements.Title: Warranty: 80k Pages or 2 Years
requirements.Description: Offer a warranty covering 80,000 pages or 2 years, whichever comes first, for Magellan printers.
requirements.Rationale: Provides assurance to SMB customers and supports value proposition of reliability.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires alignment with service and support teams.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty policy published and supported in all launch markets.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing via HP App
requirements.Description: Enable seamless mobile printing through the HP App for Magellan.
requirements.Rationale: Supports flexible work environments and is a top customer expectation for SMBs.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires app compatibility and firmware support.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Magellan is selectable and operational in HP App for mobile printing; confirmed by QA.

requirements.Title: Telemetry Requirements
requirements.Description: Implement telemetry features to support device health monitoring, usage analytics, and proactive support.
requirements.Rationale: Enables better fleet management, support, and future product improvements.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry data is collected, transmitted, and accessible in HP’s analytics platform; validated by test data.
